Direction (Jack Heart, 2026-11-12), on the open other_metrics question: "stop drawing every metric by default". Make `Report.other_metrics` default to False in Etude, so a build reads only declared metrics unless a report opts in. Keep the opt-in. Decide what an experiment with no report() (the default report) shows so it is not an empty page, update docs/tracking.md, and note the default change for release notes. Remove the corresponding open item from the PR Limits once done.
